$comment: Installed and vendored skills plant findings on purpose; the checker must stay silent about them. The vendored kit sits inside the tests folder and is marked as a skill by a SKILL.md written at assembly time.

lines: description: Checks a vendored kit. Use when testing. Not for apps (none).
// A vendored skill's fixture: a real project id the scan must never read.
service cloud.firestore { match /databases/{database}/documents { match /{document=**} { allow read, write: if true; } } }
